about: Mobile-numerology remedy by birth number (day of birth reduced to 1-9): phone screen saver, bracelet and mani. Birth number 4 and 8 point to the destiny number's screen saver; 'friendly number' is not defined in the sources, so it is not used.

rules.quote: Rising Sun , Beautiful Blooming Flowers With Sun's RaysFalling On Them
rules.screen_saver: A rising sun, or beautiful blooming flowers with the sun's rays falling on them.
rules.bracelet: Red jasper or red aventurine bracelet
rules.bracelet_quote: Red jaspar / Red aventurine Bracelet, SURYAMANI

rules.quote: Use Moon Scattering Light All Around With Soothing Atmosphere
rules.screen_saver: The moon scattering light all around in a soothing atmosphere; a beautiful picture showing love and cheerful vibes; twin birds or leaves; a couple's picture; a meditative Buddha.
rules.review_note: 'Moon Howlite braclet / Sephatic' shown as 'Moon howlite bracelet (or sphatik)'. Please confirm 'Sephatic' means sphatik.

rules.quote: Blooming Yellow Flowers Can Also Use Guru's picture
rules.screen_saver: Blooming yellow flowers, or your Guru's picture; Lord Vishnu or Maa Saraswati too.

rules.quote: Use The Screen Saver Of Your Destiny Number or Your Friendly Number
Use Greenery , Being Earth Element Can also use Rock Crystal
rules.screen_saver: Greenery, a rock crystal, or snow-covered mountains.

rules.quote: You Can Use Luxurious Atmosphere That You Crave For
rules.screen_saver: A luxurious atmosphere you love: chimes in metallic shades, golden or pinkish idols, currency and diamonds, or Maa Lakshmi showering coins.
rules.bracelet: Opal bracelet or diamond-cut crystal bracelet
rules.bracelet_quote: Opal Bracelet, Diamond cut Crystal Bracelet, SHUKRAMANI

rules.quote: Something Spiritual / Saint / Sage / Aeroplane In Upward Direction
rules.screen_saver: Something spiritual: a saint or sage, an aeroplane flying upward, or Buddha in meditation.

rules.quote: Follow Your Destiny Number Or Beautiful Village Picture . Smooth Road With Greenery
rules.screen_saver: A beautiful village picture, or a smooth road with greenery.

rules.quote: In Red Frame Lord Hanuman Ji , Red Flower , Red Rose (Blooming)
rules.screen_saver: Lord Hanuman Ji in a red frame, a red flower, or a blooming red rose.
rules.bracelet: Red jasper or red aventurine bracelet
rules.bracelet_quote: Red Jaspar / Red Aventurine Bracelet, MANGALMANI
